Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) | FBI Warns of Scammer: problems: The recreated voicemail says the caller is from a made-up 'Federal Fraud Recovery Unit', not IC3. But the 'A phone call' and 'Pay a fee first' flags rely on IC3-specific rules ('The real crime complaint center never contacts you directly…', 'The real complaint center never asks for payment…'). Since the message never claims to be IC3, these flags don't connect to what's on screen. The 'A phone call' line could also lead viewers to think any call from federal law enforcement is fake, yet Source 1 says 'individuals will be contacted by FBI employees from local field offices or other law enforcement officers' when more information is needed. Fix: have the voicemail claim to be from the FBI/IC3 about the viewer's complaint, which matches the impersonation the PSA describes, or reword the flags so they don't depend on the caller being IC3. (rewrite 1 of 2)

Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) | FBI Warns of Scammer: problems: safeMove says to 'type the official complaint site address' but never names it. The source specifically says to type www.ic3.gov and to check that it ends in .gov. Without the address, viewers can't act on the tip and may end up searching for it, which is the risky behavior the source warns against (sponsored results are often imitators). The spoken line or label should name ic3.gov. (rewrite 2 of 2)
